overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the chair could not reasonably have anticipated the Northland topic 48 hours before the January 6 meeting, so amending the notice was permitted. A second notice allegation raised late was declined.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Council added the Northland project topic to its notice within 48 hours of the January 6 meeting and then discussed it there.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Council did not violate the Open Meeting Law by amending the notice to include the unanticipated topic.

allegations.summary: In a later filing, complainant alleged the Council posted notice for the January 8 meeting before voting on January 6 to refer the matter, which the AG declined to review.
allegations.key_passage: We find that this allegation was not clearly raised in the original complaint and thus we do not review its merits.
